name: Exp_XROC2_VG_Tm
summary: This EA trades based on the XROC2_VG indicator which measures the rate of change (velocity and acceleration) of price momentum. It enters positions when momentum velocity crosses predefined thresholds and includes a time management module to restrict trading to specific sessions. The EA uses fixed lot sizing with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于XROC2_VG指标进行交易，该指标衡量价格动量的变化率（速度和加速度）。当动量速度穿越预定义阈值时开仓，并包含时间管理模块以限制在特定交易时段内交易。EA使用固定手数，带有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于XROC2_VG动量指标，该指标计算价格变化率的二阶导数（即速度和加速度），用于识别动量趋势的启动和衰减。入场条件为当动量速度指标向上穿越买入阈值时做多，向下穿越卖出阈值时做空。出场条件包括触及止损、止盈水平，或动量速度指标反向穿越出场阈值。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户资金动态调整的机制。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损和止盈参数，但没有明确的资金百分比风险控制。时间管理模块允许用户指定交易的开始和结束时间，以及每周的活跃交易日，这有助于避免低流动性时段的交易。整体策略逻辑清晰，但缺乏对市场波动性和点差的适应性过滤。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the XROC2_VG momentum indicator which computes the second derivative of price change rate (velocity and acceleration) to identify the onset and decay of momentum trends. Entry conditions trigger a long position when the momentum velocity indicator crosses above the buy threshold and a short position when it crosses below the sell threshold. Exit conditions include hitting the stop loss or take profit levels, or when the momentum velocity indicator crosses back through an exit threshold in the opposite direction. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with no dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management provides configurable stop loss and take profit parameters, but lacks percentage-based equity risk control. The time management module lets users specify trading start and end times plus active days of the week, which helps avoid low-liquidity sessions. The overall strategy logic is clear but lacks adaptive filtering for market volatility and spread conditions.
pros: 基于动量加速度的指标具有前瞻性，能较早捕捉趋势启动
时间管理模块有效避免低流动性和高点差时段的交易
策略逻辑清晰简洁，参数含义直观易于调优
pros_en: The momentum acceleration indicator is forward-looking and can capture trend initiation early
The time management module effectively avoids trading during low-liquidity and high-spread sessions
Clear and concise strategy logic with intuitive parameter meanings for easy optimization
cons: 固定手数缺乏资金管理，无法根据账户风险动态调整仓位
没有点差过滤机制，在高点差时段可能产生不利入场
缺少对已存在持仓的检查，可能在同方向重复开仓
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks money management and cannot dynamically adjust positions based on account risk
No spread filter mechanism may lead to unfavorable entries during high-spread periods
Missing check for existing positions may cause duplicate entries in the same direction
improvements: 增加基于账户权益百分比的动态仓位计算功能
添加点差过滤和波动率适配机制，避免不利市场条件下入场
加入同方向持仓检查和最大持仓数量限制
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage risk model
Add spread filter and volatility adaptation mechanism to avoid entry under unfavorable market conditions
Implement same-direction position check and maximum open position limit

risk_points: 固定手数不考虑账户规模变化，大额亏损后仍以相同仓位交易
缺少点差过滤可能导致滑点较大的不利入场
止损和止盈为固定点数，未根据市场波动率(ATR)动态调整
risk_points_en: Fixed lot sizing does not account for account size changes, maintaining same position size after large losses
Lack of spread filter may cause unfavorable entries with significant slippage
Stop loss and take profit are fixed pip values not dynamically adjusted by ATR-based volatility

summary_en: This EA trades based on the XROC2_VG indicator which measures the rate of change (velocity and acceleration) of price momentum. It enters positions when momentum velocity crosses predefined thresholds and includes a time management module to restrict trading to specific sessions. The EA uses fixed lot sizing with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
